resources.string: KidEase uses your location only while you search so we can show licensed daycares near you. Location is not used in the background.
KidEase uses the camera only while a video call or video tour is open. The camera is not used in the background.
KidEase uses the microphone only while a voice or video call is open. Calls are not recorded.
KidEase uses notifications for an incoming call. KidEase does not send ads.
